intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Surprise for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (El Mirage Winterfest and Parade) through December 24 (Christmas in the Park at Mark Coronado Park), with Sensitive Santa at Surprise Stadium (December 12), the Wickenburg Christmas Parade of Lights (December 11) and the Desert Lights Festival along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Surprise

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in Surprise, including El Mirage and Wickenburg

  • Meet Santa: Sensitive Santa at Surprise Stadium, Christmas in the Park and photos after the Wickenburg parade
  • Parades and lights: El Mirage Winterfest and Parade, the Wickenburg Parade of Lights and the Desert Lights Festival
